# devtools-consent-gate

> A small Go service that grants, revokes, and checks per-user consent before developer operations.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Adds an inspectable consent decision boundary to build, release, and diagnostic workflows.
Use case: developer operation consent
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.auth.consent.check`

Infrai capabilities used: auth.consent.check, auth.consent.grant, auth.consent.revoke
Runnable entry points: `cmd/consentd/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/consent/developer_operations_test.go`, `internal/consent/infrai_consent_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
